summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of special meeting, form of proxy, and joint management information circular for a unitholder meeting scheduled for October 14, 2026. The filing is a routine proxy and meeting notice with no disclosed transaction terms, deal structure, or special-situation event. As a foreign private issuer, this is the equivalent of a standard SEC proxy filing for a meeting. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is indicated. The filing is administrative in nature, and no deal terms are provided.
